q2_gaps: formulaic imperative interjection / discourse marker used as an exhortation ('come on now') — the Imperatives section gives no guidance on whether such a clause is reified as a Directive or dropped as non-propositional
notes: The 'stand up' half matches the Imperatives pattern exactly: the phrasal verb is kept whole as `stand_up` with no genus, the vocative addressee sits inside the seal as `Agent`, and the courtesy title stays in the `Name` string with the symbol derived from the name alone.
